extractedWith: tools/extract/extract.ps1 -Batch p6-deploy-common -Manifest <scratch copy of allowlist.manifest.yaml plus the p6-deploy-common batch> -Clean (staging %TEMP%/codelab-extract/p6-deploy-common, outside the repo; scrub findings are expected before the rewrite)
promotion: Each staged script was read as a reference and its patterns rewritten into deploy/kits/Install-Common.psm1 (tests in deploy/kits/tests); "target" is the repo file it informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder. Content is a rewrite, so the repo file hash differs from stagedSha256. Hosts, paths, accounts and product names were dropped.

origins.note: Rewritten as Install-Common.psm1: the keep-server-settings rule (settings files are never copied over; a missing server file is created from the template instead of refused), the backup before any change with logs excluded, the robocopy exit-code threshold (>= 8 is a failure) and the "nothing else changed" proof before writing (now a leaf-by-leaf comparison in Merge-AppSettings) are carried. The text-edit patch list became Merge-AppSettings: add only the keys new in the package template, never overwrite. Site discovery, the offline page, health polling and app-pool environment listing stay kit-specific (phase 8 kits). No host, path or product name was carried.

Pattern only for Copy-KitPayload: server-owned files are excluded from the copy (now appsettings.json, appsettings.*.json, app_offline.htm and logs, plus -ExcludeFiles/-ExcludeDirectories for kit-specific ones such as web.config) and the backup-then-copy order. The edge and gateway checks, the load-balancer drain text and the default public host name were not carried.

Pattern only: the deployed-folder backup became Backup-Deployment (sortable timestamp, first-install no-op, rollback is a copy back; pruning is left to the kit); the BOM-free JSON writer became the order-preserving writer that keeps the server file encoding; the locked-file clear informed the Copy-KitPayload exclusions. The config-file loader, SQL module installer and HTTP wait helper were not carried.

Pattern only: the timestamped release folder and the -WhatIf discipline (nothing written while previewing) informed Backup-Deployment. The release archive itself (zip, pruning, config file) was not carried.

Pattern only: the elevation and folder pre-checks with an actionable message informed Test-KitPrerequisites (each failed check says what to install). The SQL backup itself is a DBA concern and was not carried; the example share path was dropped.
